abi_contract.input: Live immutable nonoverlapping byte span for full call, length1..947; null/range/overflow/overlap invalid before any Rust slice.
abi_contract.output: Live writable span, capacity1..947; distinct aligned size_t written; input/output/written allocations disjoint. Validity cannot be proven from addresses.
abi_contract.guard: Acquire global nonblocking guard before ANY pointer dereference or external callback. Busy path never dereferences pointers; no Python-GIL owner assumption.
abi_contract.present: Borrow label/body/position spans only during callback; display all bytes and index/total, then fresh local action:0Next/1Approve/2Reject/3Back/4None; all other values fail display. Strong CFUNCTYPE references held until call settles.
abi_contract.clock: int32 now(uint64_t *tick):0 success, nonzero unavailable; sample same trusted monotonic source throughout. Host engineering conversion elapsed whole seconds (1 tick/s), fallible on source failure/overflow. Core100-tick lifetime unchanged; this is not an image/client/device deadline selection.
abi_contract.aux: int32 aux(uint8_t *destination,size_t capacity32): nonnegative reported count, negative error. Only32 succeeds; provider ceases writes before returning and cannot retain pointer. No fallback/automatic second attempt.
abi_contract.cancel: int32 cancelled():0 active/1 cancelled/anything else unavailable. Checked through freshness bridge before/after review and after staging; after approval core consumes before its first clock/cancel/provider callback. A blocked callback cannot be forcibly interrupted.
abi_contract.cleanup: No active owner/callback/key survives returned call; Python retains native reservation until return, then known cleanup. Crash/uncertain native outcome quarantines wrapper; no automatic reload/reuse.
